title: 2,684 website credibility evaluations and visual design comments
statement:
When 2,684 people evaluated live websites for credibility, comments about the site's visual design were the most frequent category at 46.1%, followed by information structure and information focus, so visual polish and information organization should be treated as part of credibility design rather than mere decoration. (ResearchGate)
